title: Riya vs Ikhlas: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Ek ibadat ko zaya kar deta hai... jabke doosra azeem sawab lata hai! Riya dikhaway ke liye ibadat karna hai jo aamaal ko zaya kar deta hai. Jabke Ikhlas sirf Allah ki raza ke liye amal karna hai jo ibadat ki rooh hai. Riya dikhaway ki deemak hai, jabke Ikhlas ibadat ki rooh. Aise hi Islamic comparisons ke liye follow karein.
hook_variants: Ek ibadat ko zaya kar deta hai... jabke doosra azeem sawab lata hai!
Kya aapko Riya aur Ikhlas mein farq pata hai?
Riya aur Ikhlas ko ek samajhne ki ghalti mat karein!
